clue.text: Employees using covert sign?

parts.note: covert means hidden or secret
Aries the ram is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Staff who communicate with some furtive gesture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign' looks like a gesture, but it is a star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Secretaries are office workers, so they are a type of employee.

clue.text: Highest rising American with power over British engineers

indicators.note: in a down entry, over means the power letter sits above the engineers
in a down entry, rising means the letters are read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: A US official climbing to the top with authority over a British engineering corps.
explanation.walkthrough: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers of the British Army.
explanation.definitionFit: Supreme describes the highest rank or degree, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Task mostly incorporating one group of singers

indicators.note: incorporating means the shortened task word takes the next piece inside it
mostly means the last letter of the task word is dropped

parts.note: a chore is a task
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A job that largely involves a single band of vocalists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts CHORE to CHOR, which 'incorporating' then wraps round I.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir is a body of people who sing together, as in a church.

clue.text: Skin deep, sir? I'm in need of surgery

indicators.note: something in need of surgery must be operated on and rearranged, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: A patient told that the wound is more than skin deep and needs an operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in need of surgery' rearranges DEEP, SIR and I'M. 'Skin deep' looks like one phrase, but only 'Skin' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The epidermis is the outer layer of the skin in medical terms.

clue.text: Top copy with signature of an illiterate

parts.note: to ape is to copy or mimic
someone unable to write traditionally signs with a cross, X

explanation.surface: The best imitation, bearing a mark made by someone who cannot write.
explanation.definitionFit: An apex is the highest point or peak of something.

clue.text: Plot clandestine love affair

definitions.meaning: a secret romance, an older sense of the word

explanation.surface: Planning a secret romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a scheme and, in older use, a secret love affair.

clue.text: Good deal of vision?

definitions.meaning: as in 'a ... better', meaning a great deal or a lot

explanation.surface: Asking how much someone can see.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means eyesight, and informally a great amount, as in 'a sight too much'.

clue.text: Wreckers of museum also going unprotected

parts.note: the V and A is the Victoria and Albert Museum in London

indicators.note: going unprotected means losing the outer letters that shield the word

explanation.surface: Thugs who smash up a museum, and leave its exhibits exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: The V and A is the Victoria and Albert Museum, London's museum of art and design. 'going unprotected' strips ALSO to LS.
explanation.definitionFit: Vandals are people who deliberately damage property.

clue.text: Plucky female, like Van Gogh's left?

parts.note: Van Gogh famously cut off his left ear, so that side of his head lacked one

explanation.surface: A brave woman compared to the painter's left side.
explanation.walkthrough: Van Gogh is said to have cut off his own ear, which the clue places on his left.
explanation.definitionFit: Fearless means brave, a synonym of plucky.

clue.text: Furnish with only half of rent, being thrifty

parts.note: to furnish is to provide

indicators.note: only half of means just the back two letters of the four-letter word are kept

explanation.surface: A careful tenant paying only half the rent to save money.
explanation.definitionFit: Provident means careful to save for the future, so frugal.

clue.text: Gather golfer misses regularly and finishes early

indicators.note: misses regularly means every other letter of the word is skipped
finishes early means the word stops one letter short, losing its last

explanation.surface: A golfer who keeps missing and leaves the course early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'misses regularly' keeps G, L, E from GOLFER; 'finishes early' cuts AND to AN.
explanation.definitionFit: To glean is to collect bit by bit, as gleaners pick up leftover grain.

clue.text: Fear nerves must reveal cash job

indicators.note: must reveal means the answer is shown within the letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Anxiety comes out when someone takes on work paid in cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A nice little earner is informal British for a money-making job.

clue.text: Queen falls in line!

parts.note: the name of a queen also comes before 'Falls', the African waterfall, and 'line', a London Underground line

explanation.surface: A monarch who obediently conforms.
explanation.walkthrough: Victoria Falls is on the Zambezi; the Victoria line is a London Underground line.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs to a famous queen, a waterfall and a Tube line.

clue.text: Organise a late appearance

parts.note: the late is a dead person, and making one reappear means digging up a body

explanation.surface: Arranging for someone to arrive after time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'late' looks like tardy but means deceased.
explanation.definitionFit: To dig a corpse out of its grave brings the dead person back into view.

clue.text: Fool — gangster to achieve victory over king

indicators.note: in a down entry, over means the victory word sits above the king letter

parts.note: hood is slang for a gangster
to win is to achieve victory
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A gangster tricking his way to a win against a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoodwink is to deceive or trick someone.

clue.text: Promotes coats worn by the Queen

indicators.note: worn by means the coats wrap around the next pieces, as clothes go round a wearer

parts.note: furs are fur coats
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A monarch in her fur coats.
explanation.definitionFit: Furthers means advances or helps along, as promotes does.

clue.text: Exhilarating obsession, crossing stream

indicators.note: crossing means the obsession word spans the stream word, holding it inside

parts.note: having a thing about something is an obsession
a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: The thrill of an obsession while fording a brook.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrilling means exciting, a synonym for exhilarating.

clue.text: Error ultimately found in typeface that is right for the border

indicators.note: found in means the final error letter is placed inside the typeface word

parts.note: a font is a typeface

indicators.note: ultimately means only the final letter of the word is taken

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A typesetting mistake noticed in a font that suits a page border.
explanation.definitionFit: A frontier is a border between countries.

clue.text: Tracks across poles to find supporters

indicators.note: across means the tracks extend over and around the poles

parts.note: spoors are the tracks of animals
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: An explorer following trails over the polar regions to find backers.
explanation.definitionFit: Sponsors are backers who support a cause or event.

clue.text: Poorly rewarded with this

parts.note: 'Poorly' reads as badly, but means ill: what you are paid when off work unwell

explanation.surface: Complaining about a low wage.
explanation.definitionFit: Money paid by an employer to a worker off ill.

clue.text: Mostly lying about one's time served here

indicators.note: about means the shortened lying word goes round the next piece
mostly means the last letter of the lying word is dropped

parts.note: prone means lying face down
one's is I's, written IS, with I the Roman one

explanation.surface: Someone lying about how long they spent inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' is read as I's, a Roman one with its possessive; 'time served here' is the definition, not wordplay about a sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A prisoner serves a sentence, called doing time, in a jail.

clue.text: Even without the First Lady, a trail is developing

indicators.note: without means the named letters are taken away from the word before

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible
a scent is a trail followed by hounds

explanation.surface: A trail starts to form even without the president's wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First Lady' looks like a president's wife, but here she is Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: Nascent means coming into being, just starting to develop.

clue.text: Timorous farm animal with circle on end of nose

indicators.note: on means the circle word comes straight after the letter before it

parts.note: a cow is a farm animal

indicators.note: end of means only the last letter of the word is taken

parts.note: a ring is a circle

explanation.surface: A nervous farm animal with a ring through its nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Cowering means shrinking back in fear, so timid.

clue.text: Go over limit after losing heart from race

indicators.note: after means the limit word follows the shortened race word
losing heart from means the middle letters are taken out, keeping only the ends

parts.note: a cap is a limit, as on spending

explanation.surface: Reviewing a spending limit after a runner fades in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: To recap is to summarise or go over again.

clue.text: Issues shares in carnival displays

definitions.meaning: a company does this when it first lists its stock on the market

explanation.surface: A company putting its stock on offer during a parade.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both launching a company on the market and decorated parade vehicles.

clue.text: Flooded area used to be source of hope

parts.note: was means used to be

indicators.note: source of means the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A flooded region that was once a wellspring of hope.
explanation.definitionFit: Awash means covered with water, so flooded.

clue.text: Some unimaginative bearers of gifts?

indicators.note: some means only part of the word's letters are used, found inside it

explanation.surface: Givers of uninspired presents.
explanation.definitionFit: The Magi were the three wise men who brought gifts to the infant Jesus.

clue.text: Latin American hiding his anxiety

indicators.note: hiding means the given word is put out of sight, removed from the longer word

parts.note: a Hispanic person is of Latin American origin

explanation.surface: A man from Latin America concealing his nerves.
explanation.definitionFit: Panic is sudden overwhelming fear or anxiety.

clue.text: Discovered 26 held by jailbird showing no sign of life

indicators.note: held by means the shortened piece is contained within the jailbird word

parts.note: an inmate is a prisoner

indicators.note: discovered means uncovered, losing its outer letters

parts.note: 26 refers to the answer of 26 across, meaning alarm

explanation.surface: A prisoner caught in an anxious state, apparently lifeless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discovered' means un-covered: the answer to 26 loses its first and last letters before going into the jailbird.
explanation.definitionFit: Inanimate means lifeless, without any sign of life.

clue.text: Cutting remark on past right to be transferred

indicators.note: to be transferred means these letters are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A snide comment about a past entitlement being handed to someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: A parting shot is a final barbed remark made on leaving.
